This scene:
神农和他的家人住在古代，所以不知道什么植物能吃。因为他的家人常常生病了，所以神农和他的哥哥一起去旅行找可以吃的植物。他们去很多不一样的地方，比方说高山、山谷和沙漠。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 神农和他的家人住在古代：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 因为他的家人常常生病了：常常生病，no了for routine/habit
- 他们去很多不一样的地方：去了，了completed

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住在古代：在古代生活，古代 is a time period rather than a place, so it cannot follow 住在; use 在古代 to mark the time of living. [rule: none]
2. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 常常生病了：常常生病，habitual actions use the zero particle rather than 了, because they are not single completed events. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 他们去很多不一样的地方：他们去了很多不一样的地方，this is a completed narrative action, so 去 needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “住在古代” is acceptable here and does not require changing 古代 into a time adjunct.
常常 describes a habitual situation, so 生病 should not take completed-event 了.
The trip to many places is a completed narrative action, so 去了 is needed.
